description:
Returns one career journal entry by UUID with its full text: title, type, description, entry date, metrics, tags, and the role it is linked to (experience_id, role, company).

Use this after `list_career_entries` in compact mode to open a single entry, or before `update_career_entry` to see the current text and role link.
experience_id is the integer ID of one of the user's own work experience records (a role on their GigHQ profile). Get valid IDs from `list_experiences` (or the gighq://experience resource), which returns each role's experience_id, title, and company; entries already linked to a role show it as experience_id in `list_career_entries` and `get_career_entry`. Never guess or reuse an ID from another user. GigHQ rejects IDs that aren't the user's own.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

uuid.description: UUID of the career entry. Returned by add_career_entry or list_career_entries.

name: get_career_entry
